dispositions.detected: we emit a finding of the entry's kinds in its direction (facet as stated) at the site it names, at our own level from the kind table; levelNote states where that differs from oasdiff's
dispositions.notEvaluated: the change sits under a construct the inventory does not evaluate; code is the reason our notEvaluated entry carries
dispositions.declined: in what we read but deliberately not emitted, or out of scope; reason says which
dispositions.rule: dispositions follow the inventory and the kind table, never results (D329)

typeRule: D321: a check on a schema's type value set (id *-type-changed, *-type-specialized, *-type-generalized, *-list-of-types-*) names every kind the kind table emits for a type change at B in its direction — request TYPE_NARROWED, TYPE_CHANGED, COMPOSITION_BRANCH_REMOVED; response TYPE_WIDENED, TYPE_CHANGED, COMPOSITION_BRANCH_ADDED (the matrix pairs a plain side against a composition as one branch) — and, where its location set carries a format action, the format kinds for it: set CONSTRAINT_TIGHTENED, unset CONSTRAINT_LOOSENED, change CONSTRAINT_CHANGED. null in a type array stays with the became-(not-)nullable checks.
webhookRule: D322: webhooks are compared as operations, identity webhook <name> <METHOD>, with the same kinds; a check ineligible only for WEBHOOKS becomes eligible with the kinds the kind table emits for its operation counterpart. It changes webhook-removed alone (OPERATION_REMOVED, OPERATION_REMOVED_BEFORE_SUNSET; direction none).
